question: The word 'secular' was added to the preamble of the Constitution of India in the ______ Amendment Act.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Forty-Second**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Forty-second Amendment Act, 1976, added the words "Socialist" and "Secular" to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution.
 
• This amendment is known as the Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976.
